scope: United States import unit values for the four subheadings of HS 3815, customs value divided by net weight. All grades, loadings and partners are combined, so a series is a category market level, not a catalyst-grade quote.

catalog.name: Supported catalysts with nickel or nickel compounds as the active substance
catalog.note: Covers reforming, methanation, hydrogenation and ammonia-related nickel catalysts of every loading and support.

catalog.name: Supported catalysts with precious metal or precious metal compounds as the active substance
catalog.note: Mixes automotive, refining and chemical platinum-group and silver catalysts, so the unit value follows the metal content of whatever traded that month.

catalog.name: Supported catalysts with an active substance other than nickel or precious metals
catalog.note: Copper, iron, cobalt, chromium, molybdenum and zeolite-supported catalysts.

catalog.name: Unsupported reaction initiators, accelerators and catalytic preparations
catalog.note: Bulk oxides and unsupported preparations; the cheapest category and the least like a finished supported catalyst.

HS381511.grade_note: Covers reforming, methanation, hydrogenation and ammonia-related nickel catalysts of every loading and support.

HS381519.name: Supported catalysts with an active substance other than nickel or precious metals
HS381519.grade_note: Copper, iron, cobalt, chromium, molybdenum and zeolite-supported catalysts.

HS381590.name: Unsupported reaction initiators, accelerators and catalytic preparations
HS381590.grade_note: Bulk oxides and unsupported preparations; the cheapest category and the least like a finished supported catalyst.
